import { themeQuartz } from 'ag-grid-community';

export const AgGridTheme = themeQuartz.withParams({
  fontFamily: 'Work Sans',
  fontSize: '14px',
  textColor: '#141414',
  backgroundColor: 'transparent',
  wrapperBorder: 'none',
  borderColor: '#e0e0e0',
  chromeBackgroundColor: '#fafbfc',
  subtleTextColor: '#888888',
  rangeSelectionBackgroundColor: '#e3f2fd',
  rangeSelectionHighlightColor: '#bbdefb',
  rowHoverColor: '#f5f5f5',
  columnHoverColor: '#f0f0f0',
  selectedRowBackgroundColor: '#e3f2fd',
  modalOverlayBackgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.66)',
  checkboxUncheckedBorderColor: '#cccccc',
  checkboxIndeterminateBackgroundColor: '#f5f5f5',
  checkboxIndeterminateBorderColor: '#cccccc',
  menuBorder: 'solid 1px #e0e0e0',
  menuBackgroundColor: '#fff',
  menuTextColor: '#141414',
  rowLoadingSkeletonEffectColor: '#e0e0e0',
  inputPlaceholderTextColor: '#999999',
  inputDisabledBackgroundColor: '#f5f5f5',
  inputDisabledTextColor: '#cccccc',
  wrapperBorderRadius: '0',
});
